title: CrashCoinFlip
description: I created a coin flip plugin because I couldn’t find one that fit my needs
body:
**The ultimate solution for COINFLIP** [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wiki-Documentation-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=gitbook)](https://github.com/CrashWho/CrashCoinFlip/wiki) [![CodeRefactor](https://img.shields.io/badge/CodeRefactor-A%2B-success?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/crashwho/crashcoinflip)
## ✨ Key Features

🚀 High Performance

Optimized to run without lag, even with high player counts. Lightweight and fast.


⚙️ Fully Configurable

Every aspect of the plugin can be customized in the config.yml file.

🛡️ Security

Full protection against dupes and exploits.


💾 Custom Messages & Models

Native support for MiniMessage, so you can use every color you want! This plugin also supports items component & custom model data!
## 📦 Dependencies To use this plugin, you must have the following installed on your server: * **Vault** (Required for economy bridging) * **ProtocolLib** (Required for packet handling) * **An Economy Plugin** (Any plugin compatible with Vault, e.g., EssentialsX, CMI, etc.) --- ## 📸 Screenshots
--- ## 📜 Commands & Permissions ### Player Commands - `/coinfip` - Open the basic coinflip GUI. - `/coinflip cancel` - Cancel the coinflip. ### Admin Commands - `/coinflip reload` - Reloads the configuration file.
Click to view the full Permissions list | Permission | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `coinflip.use` | Allows access to basic commands | | `coinflip.reload` | Reload the configuration |
